description: Legacy-era rows record their owner only in the agent column. Pre-2026-11-21 sibling-stack synapses wrote pr_registry rows with a non-default agent column and no metadata.agent or metadata.bot_id (azylman/aerial-config#735: agent 'suletta', status ci_failed). Hydrate resolves the owner through RowOwner (metadata.agent, else metadata.bot_id, else a non-default agent column), so PRObject owns it as 'suletta'. Every main push fans out main_advanced to the open PR and the shadow compare re-reads the row; comparing the raw metadata.agent key counted a divergence for an ownership both sides agree on (g3-shadow-soak-r6). CompareProjection compares the effective owner instead: the column-only row agrees, records no intended effect, while a row whose explicit metadata.agent names another owner ('miorine') still diverges on metadata.agent.

cases.name: column-only owner agrees after main advanced
explicit metadata agent naming another owner still diverges
